description: Gate A W4 (A05/A08/A10/A11) UI Lab visual-review evidence. Not an approved golden — requires human approval.
knownLimitations: Captured LOCALLY in this agent sandbox session against a local next dev server (http://localhost:3333), not a GitHub Actions CI runner — unlike every prior Gate A wave, whose attestations were CI-sourced. An earlier Gate A W3 session disclosed an HMR-WebSocket hydration failure that blocked local capture entirely in that sandbox; that failure did not reproduce in this session (all 694 Gate A captures across W1-W4 completed cleanly, zero console/page errors, zero warnings) — environment-dependent, not fixed in source.

The underlying PNG files exist only in this session's ephemeral test-results/ui-lab-review/ directory and were NOT committed to the repository or uploaded as a durable artifact (consistent with every prior wave's "do not commit large PNG binaries" policy) — they will not persist once this session ends. A future reviewer must re-run scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs against sourceCommitSha to regenerate byte-identical images and independently verify these hashes; a CI run of the ui-lab-visual-review.yml workflow against this PR's head would additionally produce a durable (7-day) GitHub Actions artifact.
Gate A W4 scenarios (scenario slugs prefixed gate-a-w4-) are CANDIDATE only — see docs/ui-lab/gate-a-w4-candidates/.
This attestation also confirms (by the full 694-capture run completing with zero errors) that no W4 addition to scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs regressed any W1-W3 capture.
